validationContract.units: fft.cpp hash names <source>_n<size>_inv_<inverse>[_precomputed]: the host's for the 61 entries fft.cpp reaches, gate-local plans by the same rules for the other 40
validationContract.lengths: per kernel and threadgroup memory, the longest planned length whose plan uses the most radices; Bluestein convolves at the memory size; Rader at 4096 points plans past MAX_RADER_FFT_SIZE
validationContract.cases: 2 * threadgroup batch + 1 transforms, or 3; both directions of complex transforms; Bluestein's first and last convolved length; one pass per four-step unit
validationContract.inputs: test_fft's: real and imaginary parts uniform in [0, 1)
validationContract.reference: numpy.fft in double precision; the four-step step 0 temporary is the column DFTs times exp(-2 pi i k1 c / (n1 n2)), and step 1 reads its float32 rounding
validationContract.tolerance: test_fft: atol 1e-4 below 1025 points, else 1e-3; 1e-2 from 2^17 points; rtol 1e-4, relative to the device output
validationContract.guards: 32 guards past every output's footprint stay untouched; inputs end in poisoned elements and must stay unchanged
validationContract.metalUpstreamComparison: the unchanged upstream kernel with the same function constants, word for word over the whole output buffer
validationContract.complex32: Metal: word-for-word upstream identity; Direct3D and OpenGL refuse with project.translate.resource-aggregate-unsupported (workgroup-allocation-layout) pending https://github.com/CrossGL/crosstl/issues/4576
